intelligence-iq-curve.alt: A bell-shaped normal curve of modern IQ scores with a mean of 100 and a standard deviation of 15. Marks at 55, 70, 85, 100, 115, 130 and 145 are z scores of minus 3 to plus 3. By the 68-95-99.7 rule, 34% of scores fall between 85 and 100 and 34% between 100 and 115, so 68% score 85 to 115; 13.5% fall in each band from 70 to 85 and 115 to 130; 2.35% in each band from 55 to 70 and 130 to 145. The percentile at each mark is 0.15, 2.5, 16, 50, 84, 97.5 and 99.85.
